lines.t: It's a splendid ruin, isn't it?
Though calling it "splendid" is odd...
It must have been so lively
back then...
{{ryoma}}
Yeah.
That a town where so many people lived

could end up like this in just a few
decades...
It feels really strange.
{{ryoma}}
It's the fate of mining towns.

When the stones run out, so does the
town.
{{exploration_club_pres_kunigiku}}
Is that really so?
...Huh?
{{exploration_club_pres_kunigiku}}
Haven't you heard about the accident?
Um...
{{exploration_club_pres_kunigiku}}

They say there was a major accident at
the mine long ago.
It was hardly reported in the news,
but if you read the few records,

you can tell it closed right after the
accident.
{{ryoma}}

So the accident was the direct cause of
the closure?

Are you saying it wasn't {{medalia}} running
out...?
{{exploration_club_pres_kunigiku}}
Mmm.
I just thought it might be possible.
Oh well.
This isn't the time to talk about it.
Shall we head back before it gets dark?
